---
title: "Others"
format: html
editor: visual
---
```{r}
dat_mind <- openesm::get_dataset("0059_blanke")$data[, c("id", "attention_present", "opened_up", "concentrated_present", "nonjudgmental_feelings", "nonjudgmental_thoughts", "nonjudgmental_behavior")]

head(dat_mind)
```

```{r}
dat_mind$mind <- rowMeans(
  dat_mind[, c("mind.1","mind.2","mind.3","mind.4", "mind.5","mind.6")],
  na.rm = TRUE
)

library(lme4)

m0 <- lmer(
  mind ~ 1 + (1|id),
  data = dat_mind
)

library(performance)

icc(m0)

VarCorr(m0)
```

```{r}
dat_mind %>%
  tidyr::drop_na("mind.1") |>
  count(id, name = "n_datapoints")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

obs_count <- dat_mind %>%
  count(id)

ggplot(obs_count,
       aes(x = n)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1,
                 color = "black",
                 fill = "skyblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Observations per Person",
    x = "Number of Observations",
    y = "Number of Participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)

dat_mind <- dat_mind |>
  dplyr::rename(mind.1 = attention_present,
                mind.2 = opened_up,
                mind.3 = concentrated_present,
                mind.4 = nonjudgmental_feelings,
                mind.5 = nonjudgmental_thoughts,
                mind.6 = nonjudgmental_behavior)
```



```{r}
library(tidyr)

dat_mind %>%
  tidyr::drop_na("mind.1") |>
  count(id, name = "n_datapoints")
```
```{r}
descriptives_mind <- psych::describe(
  dplyr::select(dat_mind,
                mind.1, mind.2, mind.3, mind.4, mind.5, mind.6)
)

View(descriptives_mind)
```

```{r}
model_mind <- '
level: 1
mind =~ mind.1 + mind.2 + mind.3 + mind.4 + mind.5 + mind.6

level:2
mind.1 ~~ mind.2 + mind.3 + mind.4 + mind.5 + mind.6
mind.2 ~~ mind.3 + mind.4 + mind.5 + mind.6
mind.3 ~~ mind.4 + mind.5 + mind.6
mind.4 ~~ mind.5 + mind.6
mind.5 ~~ mind.6 
'

fit_mind <- cfa(
  model_mind,
  data = dat_mind,
  cluster = "id"
)
```
```{r}
config_results_mind <- cluster_fit(
  fit_mind,
  fit._measures = c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "rmsea", "cfi", "mindmr"),
  constraint = "none",
  check.gradient = FALSE,
  warn = FALSE
)

head(config_results_mind)
```
